why: Carry the G 1e-17, s 1.5152, 1.25 M_Ch star past central-hydrogen exhaustion with the new relaxation solver (relax=1), the partial-ionization gas in its envelope (cool=1: Saha, mixing length, grey photosphere, alpha 1.61 carried from ours) and a 2% energy-balance tolerance (baltol=0.02; the thin burning shell crossing the composition grid costs ~1-2% a step). Shooting stalled at 15.112 Gyr (evolve4-16 to -19); in the sandbox relaxation follows the star into a giant that settles near 3,300 K, 4D's Hayashi line. Pinned gravity's quadrature is fixed in this code (it was 0.4-4% weak), so the first models carry that transient. The question: does the core reach the 1 M_Ch it needs to explode.

groups.name: ev20-00
cmds: node four/atom/tools/evolve.mjs four 1e-17 1.5152 1.25 grav=1 Hstop=1e-30 fit=0.1 loose=1e-3 relax=1 cool=1 baltol=0.02
